claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 accurately states the employer's requirement to distribute portable fire extinguishers for Class A fires such that employee travel distance is 75 feet (22.9 m) or less, correctly capturing the actor, modal force, threshold, and object.

Claim C0001 correctly captures the core duty to maintain extinguishers fully charged and operable in designated places, but omits the explicit temporal boundary exception 'except during use', resulting in boundary and summary errors.

Claim C0002 faithfully reproduces the exemption from paragraph (d) distribution requirements for employers with qualifying emergency action plans designating specific authorized extinguisher users and requiring immediate evacuation of other employees.
Claim C0003 correctly states the scope limitation that paragraph (d) does not apply to portable fire extinguishers provided for employee use on the outside of workplace buildings or structures.

unit_judgments.rationale: The general scope provision defining the application of § 1910.157 to placement, use, maintenance, and testing of employee extinguishers is not represented by any focus claim.
Claim C0003 accurately and fully covers the exemption of outside building/structure extinguishers from paragraph (d).
The exemption limiting requirements to paragraphs (e) and (f) when extinguishers are provided but not intended for employee use has no counterpart in the draft claims.
The full section exemption under (b)(1) for total evacuation policies with no extinguishers available is omitted as a stand-alone claim.
Claim C0002 fully captures the exemption from paragraph (d) distribution requirements under paragraph (b)(2).
The requirement in (c)(1) to provide, mount, locate, and identify accessible extinguishers without subjecting employees to injury is not extracted.
The requirement in (c)(2) that only approved portable fire extinguishers be used is missing from the draft claims.
The prohibition in (c)(3) against carbon tetrachloride or chlorobromomethane extinguishing agents is not represented.
Claim C0001 extracts the maintenance and designated placement duties of (c)(4) but omits the explicit boundary condition 'except during use'.
The requirement in (c)(5) to remove soldered or riveted shell inverting-type extinguishers from service is missing from the draft.
The general selection and distribution requirement based on hazard class, size, and degree in (d)(1) is not extracted.
Claim C0000 completely and accurately retains the 75-foot travel distance requirement for Class A fire extinguishers under (d)(2).
The permission in (d)(3) to use standpipe systems or hose stations instead of Class A extinguishers under specified conditions is not extracted.
The 50-foot travel distance distribution requirement for Class B fires under (d)(4) is missing from the draft.
The distribution rule for Class C hazards based on Class A or B patterns under (d)(5) is not extracted.
The 75-foot travel distance distribution requirement for Class D extinguishing agents under (d)(6) is not extracted.
The bi-weekly generation threshold requiring Class D extinguishers in combustible metal working areas under (d)(6) is missing.
